answer: To achieve Sybil resistance among autonomous agents, the grove mechanism enforces stake-slashing matrices where malicious nodes suffer strictly negative expected utility due to prohibitive capital lockup. Each broadcast signal must cryptographically validate the locked stake; an invalid signal triggers immediate slashing, while valid ones form an unforgeable river of validator reputation. This sustains Byzantine Fault Tolerance because attacking the network is strictly dominated by honest participation, forcing adversaries into an insurmountable economic barrier.
